items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: You know who else was a nice person in the band, Danny Turner

ctx.x: It’s like Scott Hamilton when he first came out, he was just 40 pounds dripping wet. And that horn was bigger than he was.
You know who else was a nice person in the band, Danny Turner, who also just recently passed away. Did you know Danny?
